questions.prompt: Compared with a single-raised pot, a limped pot should be played…

choices.text: Smaller, with fewer bluffs and thinner value.

questions.explanation: The preflop action is the tell. No raise means wider, weaker ranges.

questions.prompt: Oversized bets with one pair in a limped pot…

choices.text: Fold out the worse hands and get called by better.

questions.explanation: That is the opposite of thin value.

questions.prompt: A limped flop that is four-way changes bluffing by…

choices.text: Cutting it. More players, fewer successful bluffs.

questions.explanation: Player count and pot family stack. Both say check the air.

questions.prompt: You may still isolate a limper preflop. After the flop is already multiway and limped…

choices.text: The isolation failed. Play a multiway pot, not a heads-up raised pot.
